identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

theme_strategy.description: A 'Command Center' aesthetic. Stark contrasts for data legibility. Color is used strictly for function (status, alerts) and branding, never for decoration.

headings.usage: Main page titles, section headers, modal titles. Use tight tracking.

body.usage: General text, data tables, form inputs.

mono.usage: Contract IDs, Financial figures, API keys.

rules: Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase + tracking-widest + text-xs
Line height: tight for headers, relaxed for body

layout.spacing: Generous (2-3x standard). Use p-6, p-8 for containers.
rules: Gap: gap-4 or gap-6 (Tight for dashboard)
Every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children.

cards.style: Flat, 1px border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), no shadow by default.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-md px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.destructive: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 rounded-md px-6 py-2

inputs.style: bg-white border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent rounded-md h-10

map.style: Full height container. Floating panels with Glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky headers and map overlays. bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/20.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain on solid backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Layered shadows (ambient + direct) for floating elements.

assets.icons: Lucide React (default). Use Phosphor Icons for marketing sections if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Problems-first' dashboard using the Bento Grid Mode B.
Use Recharts for all data visualization. Keep charts clean and minimal.
Use React-Leaflet for the map. Custom markers are mandatory.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (APCA standards).
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise.
For the 'Reputation' feature, use a 5-star system with explicit text tags (e.g., 'Reliable', 'Late Payer').
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic (generic centered layouts, purple gradients).
Create depth through z-index and layered elements.
Micro-animations for all interactions (hover, focus, active).
Export components as named exports, pages as default exports.
